about: Every sound tool soundlab can use or point to. `soundlab scan` scores all of them against an idea. Roles: bed, harmony, melody, rhythm, bass, environment, texture, space, color, master, reference. Status: ready = renders here; manual = a person runs it; reference = listen only;

tools.name: Beating sine drone
tools.what: Root + fifth + octave with slow beating, random swell.

tools.name: Saw pad (ambient.py)
tools.what: Slow detuned saw-ish chords with long crossfades; optional tape wow.

tools.name: Bowed cello line

tools.name: Motion drone (Ambient Studio)

tools.name: Wind (Ambient Studio)

tools.name: Coloured noise bed
